description: Cart composable passes subtotalCents.value (a plain number) into useFormattedPrice, whose computed() closes over the parameter, so formattedSubtotal never changes after the first call; the rest of the composable replaces reactive arrays correctly

hard.note: A single .value read at the call site freezes a computed; the computed itself looks correct in isolation

_calibration.note: Window modeled on the framework's existing *-reactivity-issues fixture (one error per planted defect), narrowed to the single planted defect plus room for one incidental warning or suggestion.
